description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that serves as the main launcher for an app demonstrating a reveal effect. It manages UI components such as fragment transactions, menus, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends a base activity and manages fragment setup, options menu handling, and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the RevealEffectBasicFragment if no previous state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu items, showing/hiding the log toggle based on view existence.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items, toggling the log view display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain with wrappers and filters, displaying logs in the UI.
